review_candidates.description: About the Role: We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to maintain, optimize, and continuously improve the CI/CD platform, infrastructure-as-code, and operational practices for a mature, stable multi-environment AWS ecosystem. The solution is fully developed and in production; the focus is on continuous improvement, cost optimization, reliability, and operational excellence. Additionally, the project is undergoing an AI-First transformation, adopting AWS Kiro and custom AI agents to implement an AI-driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC). You will work closely with development squads to ensure fast, reliable, and secure delivery of enhancements and fixes. Key Responsibilities: Maintain and evolve CI/CD pipelines (AWS CodeBuild, CodePipeline) ensuring reliability and speed of delivery Maintain and improve Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK (Python primarily, some TypeScript) across multiple AWS accounts Optimize serverless infrastructure performance, cost, and reliability (Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, Step Functions, EventBridge) Improve and extend observability solutions (CloudWatch, OpenSearch dashboards, structured logging, alerting) Continuously strengthen security posture including IAM policies, KMS encryption, Secrets Manager, and network segmentation Maintain and tune data infrastructure components (RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, DynamoDB, S3) Review and improve disaster recovery strategies, backup automation, and rollback mechanisms Support multi-account governance and cross-account resource management Collaborate with development teams on deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, feature flags) Drive operational excellence through runbooks, incident response procedures, and post-mortem processes Apply FinOps practices to monitor, optimize, and report on cloud cost and resource utilization Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives across infrastructure, pipelines, and operational processes Contribute to the AI-First transformation by integrating AI agents and AI-assisted workflows into the development and operations lifecycle Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis Mentor junior team members on cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices Key Challenges: Sovereign Cloud: reduce footprint on vendor lock-in AWS solutions and migrate workloads toward containers and cloud-native standard technologies Migration and Modernization: plan and execute application and workload migration to AWS through 2029 Propose improvements and new solutions at the weekly architecture board for cost reduction, operational improvements, and adoption of new AWS or market features What We Offer: Access and incentive to pursue multiple certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub, AI, and more) Be part of a 60+ DevOps engineering community, working across 25+ projects in different industries and countries Collaborative environment with internal and external meet-ups, happy hours, and challenges beyond project work Access to leading AI tools and platforms Opportunity to work on a high-impact EU institutional project with modern serverless architecture Active AI-First transformation with cutting-edge AI-assisted development practices Required Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Amazon Web Services (AWS) - multi-account environments Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK with Python/TypeScript; CloudFormation) CI/CD pipeline design and management (CodeBuild, CodePipeline, or equivalent) Containerization and orchestration (Docker, ECS/Fargate) Serverless architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge) Networking (VPC, subnets, security groups, PrivateLink, CloudFront) Monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, OpenSearch, structured logging) Scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell) Database operations (PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB) Security hardening (IAM, KMS, WAF, Secrets Manager) Maintain and enforce security and quality gates across CI/CD pipelines (OWASP Dependency Check, Prowler, SonarQube, AWS Config, ECR image scanning) FinOps fundamentals (cost allocation, tagging strategies, resource optimization) Desired Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in DevOps/Platform Engineering roles Experience with multi-environment deployment strategies and release management Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery (Jira, Confluence) Experience with Git workflows and branching strategies Understanding of compliance and data sovereignty requirements (EU context) Interest or experience in AI-assisted development tools and workflows Strong communication skills and ability to work independently as an SME Active participation in team discussions and problem-solving Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of optimizing processes and reducing waste Legal: Must own a valid work permit or EU/Schengen Space Nationality to legally work in Portugal What We Offer Health insurance; Life Insurance and Pension Plan Programs; Free medical services at the office (Physician, Nutritionist, Psychologist); Wellness programs; Flexben Program (Support for Education, Kindergarden, Training, Technology, Health); Employee Share Purchase Plan; Personalized training paths and access to Udemy and Plurisight Plataforms; Flex-ability program (financial and flexible support for people with disabilities); Special banking conditions; Hybrid working model.
